```
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: hello.txt
+Hello world
*** Update File: src/app.py
*** Move to: src/main.py
@@ def greet():
-print("Hi")
+print("Hello, world!")

+Hello world

*** Move to: src/main.py
@@ def greet():
-print("Hi")

*** Delete File: obsolete.txt
*** End Patch
